name: stream-compaction-coordinator
summary: Durable control plane for append-only stream segment rollover, compaction, replica acknowledgement, and restart recovery.

modules.responsibility: parse bounded runtime settings and defaults
entities, range arithmetic, transitions, and validation
snapshot codec, atomic publication, and catalog access
workflow orchestration, mutation serialization, and recovery
JSON entry points, request limits, and error mapping

workflows.name: Register, append, and roll over
steps: seal and replace the active segment at the threshold
workflows.success: returns the stream revision and either the expanded or newly open segment
workflows.failure: returns a stable validation, conflict, overflow, or persistence error without partial mutation
workflows.verification: verify append-rollover exercises HTTP creation, append, threshold rollover, and durable readback

workflows.name: Plan, finish, and recover compaction
steps: atomically commit a compacted result and retire sources
reload the snapshot and abort an interrupted running plan
workflows.success: returns a completed plan and advances the compaction floor
workflows.failure: rejects gaps, overlaps, invalid state, stale generation, or unsafe finish data and preserves recoverability
workflows.verification: verify compaction-recovery runs completion and interrupted-plan recovery through the HTTP path

workflows.name: Acknowledge replicas and recover the watermark
steps: validate segment generation and acknowledgement range
reduce live segment boundaries into a safe watermark
reload and recompute the watermark after restart
workflows.success: returns an updated acknowledgement and a monotonic stream watermark
workflows.failure: rejects stale generations, retired segments, decreasing offsets, and damaged snapshots
workflows.verification: verify replica-watermark acknowledges replicas, checks reduction, restarts, and reads the recovered watermark
